2: 
3: > **SINGLE-USER (locked).** Membership, invites, and thread sharing are
4: > REMOVED — no `workspace_members`/`invites`/`thread_shares`, no roles, no
5: > INVITES group, no shared-workspace key overrides, no share preview page.
6: > The owner IS the only user of a workspace. See db/SCHEMA.md banner.
7: > Old multi-user claims below are rewritten to this reality.
8: 
9: Replaces the old tRPC + regex-decision + god-class backend. The system becomes:
10: 
11: ```
12: Browser (Next.js client, zustand stores)
13:    │  useChat (Vercel AI SDK @ai-sdk/react 4.x)
14:    ▼
15: /workspace/[workspaceId]/[threadId]   (client page, no full reload on swap; workspaceId selects context/sidebar)
16:    │
17:    ▼  POST /api/chat (ChatTransport → streamText)
18:    │
19:    ├── live (fast) tools: askUserQuestion, showPlan, editPlan, memory tools,
20:    │                      HTTP request tool, media tools (image/transcription live)
21:    │
22:    └── durable (Anakin/Inngest) tools: delegateAgenticWork (one tool)
23:                │
24:                ▼  inngest.send("thread/run")
25:                ▼  Inngest fn "thread-runner" streams run_activities rows
26:                ▼  Supabase Realtime → ChatMessage updates live in place
27: ```
28: 
29: ## A. Auth (Supabase, Google only, MVP)
30: 
31: - Root `page.tsx` = login screen. `supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({provider:"google"})`.
32: - `onLinkIdentity`/redirect to `/workspace` after signup (resolves the
33:   user's `is_default` workspace → `/workspace/[workspaceId]`).
34: - Post-signup flow: pre-questions driven by a JSON config (role/usecase/goal,
35:   multi+single select; user edits the JSON, app maps it to QuestionFlow). Answers
36:   → `user_profiles.pre_answers`. If signup exists but profile row missing → auto
37:   navigate to onboarding (create on demand).
38: - `useSupabaseUser()` hook (zustand + Supabase client). Middleware/proxy
39:   (`src/proxy.ts` evlog) still runs; tRPC session shim removed — server routes
40:   read `createServerClient` session from cookies.
41: - Sessions: Supabase handles refresh (`@supabase/ssr` cookie-based). Server
42:   side: `createServerClient` with anon/publishable; protected route checks user.
43: 
44: ## B. Realtime plumbing
45: 
46: - **Supabase Realtime** on tables: `chat_messages`, `run_activities`,
47:   `approval_requests`, `notifications` (private channels, JWT-auth user filters).
48: - Client hooks: `useChatRealtime(threadId)` merges live broadcast rows into the
49:   chat store / useChat message list. **This is how Inngest-produced activity
50:   reaches the UI** (durable work streams to an open chat).
51: - Room id convention `thread:{threadId}` on Realtime channel.
52: 
53: ## C. Chat transport & message appending (the "no new message every tool" rule)
54: 
55: Streaming in web via `POST /api/chat` using `ChatTransport` protocol:
56: - Drive `messages` from DB via `chat_messages`, feed to `streamText`.
57: - **Live LLM path**: `streamText({model, messages, tools, toolApproval,
58:   stopWhen: isStepCount(maxSteps), system: composeSystem(workflow, plan, memory)})`
59:   → `toUIMessageStream` → `createUIMessageStreamResponse`. Returns typed
60:   `UIMessage` parts; `useChat`/`Chat` client keeps ONE assistant message alive
61:   and appends tool parts to it.
62: - **Durable path**: when a tool needs Inngest (Anakin, browser, sleep/schedule),
63:   the route/handler calls `inngest.send("thread/run", …)` and returns a
64:   "delegated" tool part with the `run_id`; UI shows ThinkingSteps derived from
65:   `run_activities` streamed in. When the run completes, the ChatMessage gets a
66:   final assistant part (result text). No new message bubbles for sub-steps —
67:   everything appends to the same assistant message.
68: - **New ChatMessage(assistant) triggers** ONLY: error, warning, workflow stops
69:   unexpectedly, user stops → user clicks Run again. (Per user rule.)
70: 
71: ```tsx
72: // client pseudocode — the appending contract
73: const { messages, sendMessage, addToolResult, stop } = useChat({ api: "/api/chat", id: threadId });
74: // useChat actually uses Chat/DefaultChatTransport — bridge in provider
75: ```
76: 
77: ## D. Tool surface (LLM-invocable, zod schemas, NEVER hardcoded)
78: 
79: | Tool | When | Runs |
80: |---|---|---|
81: | `askQuestion` | clarifying questions (any time LLM needs) | live — returns `AskUserQuestion[]` JSON → UI renders ask-user-questions (MCQ) |
82: | `showPlan` | ONLY when user explicitly asks to plan/workflow (NO auto-plan) | live — returns `{steps: [...], header}` → AccordionGroup |
83: | `editPlan` | add/remove/update any step | live — persists `plan_steps` |
84: | `finalizeAndInject` | user approves → bind thread↔workflow, set status | live + sends thread/run if "run" chosen |
85: | `bindWorkflow` (variant) | approve-but-not-run | live — bind only, workflow idle; Run button appears, Stop hidden. Run toggles→Stop while running |
86: | `storeMemory` / `searchMemory` | thread + global memory (mem0) | live (mem0 low-latency); ONE mem0 store per user, thread scoped by metadata |
87: | `httpRequest` | user bearer token, arbitrary HTTP | live — raw fetch; https-only, private-IP blocked, size/max-redirect caps |
88: | `delegateAgenticWork` | ANY Anakin capability (search/scrape/crawl/map/research/wire/browser + schedule) | durable → Inngest `thread/run`; returns run_id |
89: | `generateImage` / `transcribeAudio` | media generation requests | live when `IMAGE_MODEL`/`TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` set per workspace/env |
90: 
91: - `askQuestion` → `AskUserQuestion` schema (packages/ui
92:   `ask-user-questions.tsx:37`) — single zod schema shared server+client.
93: - Auto-approve switch: toolApproval config + `approval_requests` row status
94:   auto-"approved" when workflow.auto_approve; system message emitted
95:   "auto-approved via settings".
96: - **NO auto-plan/wiring**: LLM answers plain text, never auto-creates a plan or
97:   binds a workflow on its own. `showPlan` only fires after user explicitly asks
98:   ("create a workflow / plan this"). A 2nd user message is NOT a plan trigger.
99: - **Attachments → LLM-readable**: image/pdf/video dropped into ChatComposer get
100:   converted to LLM input parts (image → data URL / base64 image part; pdf →
101:   extracted text part) before the call; media tools return real content.
102: 
103: ## E. Durable execution (Inngest): `thread/run`
104: 
105: - ONE event: `thread/run` (down from pile). `thread-runner` function:
106:   1. fetch everything from DB (thread, plan, memory summaries, previous runs).
107:   2. `generateText`/`ToolLoopAgent` with the SAME tool set minus the durable
108:      re-delegation (no recursion);
109:   3. persist each step/tool into `runs` + `run_activities` + broadcast.
110:   4. sleep/resume via `runs.status=sleeping` + `schedule-tick` (real Inngest
111:      cron trigger; fires due `schedules` + wakes sleeping runs; sees `webhook_hooks`
112:      fired → `trigger=resume`) — and register ALL functions
113:      in `apps/web/src/app/api/inngest/route.ts` serve list.
114:   5. notify on completion/failure → `notifications`.
115: - Idempotency: `runs.status` gate `pending→running` with `select … for update`
116:   in Postgres; retries honor existing activity instead of re-running.
117: - Cost caps: check BEFORE each step (realtime), not after the run (fix the
118:   old post-hoc bug).
119: - Bounded recovery: attempt count tracked in `run_activities`
120:   (`type=system`, `step_label="recovery"`, detail) against
121:   `EXECUTION_MAX_RECOVERY_ATTEMPTS` — no separate table.
122: 
123: ## F. Frontend state (zustand)
124: 
125: - Zustand stores (each `[thread]`, `[sidebar]`, `[chatComposer]`, `[ui/theme]`,
126:   `[auth]`) — keeps server components pure; zustand used max; no useState sprawl.
127: - `threadId` navigation: `router.push('/workspace/'+workspaceId+'/'+id, { scroll:false })` — both segments carried; a thread is always viewed from the context workspace (own PERSONAL or a joined workspace).
128:   updating only param; page reads `params.threadId` once → store. ChatComposer
129:   layout: centered when no messages → bottom once first message exists.
130: - ChatComposer: queue (ordered, editable, removable, durable-backend),
131:   token-quality slider formula: `maxTokens per CHAT request` (this is what the
132:   slider means; maps to `streamText.maxOutputTokens`, not a run budget),
133:   file/image/pdf attach → compress (canvas, WebP, quality 0.8, max 2000px) →
134:   Supabase Storage → `files` row + `UIMessage` attachments.
135: - Queue `chat_messages.status=queued`: on run finish, drain SEQUENTIALLY —
136:   deliver message, wait for that response to finish, then next (no parallel
137:   queue burst). Edited/reordered queue → DB rows updated in place, order kept.
138: 
139: ## G. Memory (mem0, ONE place per user, thread-scoped)
140: 
141: - ONE mem0 store per app user (as chosen): every thread's memories live there,
142:   scoped by `metadata.threadId`. `storeMemory`/`searchMemory` tools:
143:   - thread scope: `{scope:"thread", threadId}` — memories only reprompted for
144:     that thread.
145:   - global scope: `{scope:"global"}` — **program-given memory injected
146:     beforehand**, works across ALL workspaces/threads/apps for that user (not
147:     per-workspace). E.g. capability schemas, user prefs, standing instructions.
148: - `packages/agent/src/adapters/README.md:1` resolution: adapter schemas exposed
149:   to LLM via GLOBAL memory (per decision) — one tool `listCapabilities` returns
150:   schemas; keeps them OO-reflectable.
151: 
152: ## I. Permission model — SINGLE-USER (no invites, roles, or sharing)
153: 
154: - Each `auth.users` row owns exactly ONE workspace (`workspaces.created_by`),
155:   created at signup as "Personal" (is_default). Owner = the only user.
156: - All RLS is owner-only (`user_id`/`created_by` = `auth.uid()`); child tables
157:   (runs, run_activities, chat_messages, plans, approval_requests, schedules)
158:   chain through their thread/workflow to the owner. No membership reads.
159: - Tables `workspace_members`, `invites`, `thread_shares` and enums `role`,
160:   `thread_role`, `invite_kind`, `invite_status` are DROPPED (migration 0004 +
161:   raw supabase cleanup, applied to prod).
162: 
163: ### Keys resolution order (chat / run)
164: ```
165: 1. workspace keys (the workspace the thread belongs to)
166: 2. env defaults (ANAKIN_API_KEY / GROQ_API_KEY / MEM0_API_KEY / models)
167: ```
168: (No member-override step; no `prefer_own_keys_in_shared` toggle.)
169: 
170: ## J. Packages map (rewrite targets)
171: 
172: | Package | Old | New |
173: |---|---|---|
174: | `@aevryn/auth` | better-auth | Supabase client + SSR + google + onboarding trigger |
175: | `@aevryn/api` | tRPC router | dropped for chat (chat = `POST /api/chat`); keep minimal health/metadata route if needed |
176: | `@aevryn/agent` | runtime + registry + regex | `runAgent` live (streamText), durable `thread-runner`, tools from schema library |
177: | `@aevryn/workflow` | god service 66 methods | split: thread-service, plan-service, run-service, activity-service, notification-service, key-service, queue-service, schedule-service, webhook-hook-service (NO member-service — removed) |
178: | `@aevryn/inngest` | 3 functions, 1 served | serve ALL fns; `thread-runner` + `schedule-tick` (Inngest cron) + notify |
179: | `@aevryn/db` | 16 tables legacy | new SCHEMA.md (14 tables) + `schedules`/`webhook_hooks` + Supabase migration |
180: | `@aevryn/env` | server only | server + web split, USER keys via DB Vault (see ENV.md) |
181: | `@aevryn/ui` | components (keep) | real-data wiring (dropdown, nav, dialogs), ChatMessage attachments, ProfileDialog, Toaster mount |
182: 
183: ## K. Flow verification scenarios (must "just work")
184: 
185: 1. **"Hi"** → user text only, LLM plain text, NO tool call, NO new workflow.
186: 2. **"plan me a laptop comparison"** → LLM askQuestion (MCQ) → user answers →
187:    showPlan accordion → workflowApproval (approve/decline/bind/run) → bind →
188:    `thread/run` → ThinkingSteps stream research/scrape sub-tasks into the SAME
189:    assistant message → final answer text appended.
190: 3. **"scrape X.com profile" (no plan)** → delegateAgenticWork → durable run →
191:    run_activities stream → final text in same message.
192: 4. **user closes tab mid-run** → run continues in Inngest; reopening
193:    workspace reloads `chat_messages` + `run_activities` → renders state.
194: 5. **queued "delete workflow" while run active** → message queued durable;
195:    once run completes → queued delivered SEQUENTIALLY (wait each).
196: 6. **auto-approve ON** → approval resolves instantly + system message.
197: 9. **deleted thread** → soft-archive 30 days (trash), recover → live;
198:    after 30 days hard-delete (incl. runs/activities/files).
199: 10. **"re-run last run"** → play a rerun (trigger=rerun) with same plan, no
200:     new chat; hits new `runs` row, streams activities again.
201: 11. **first message** → auto-titles thread; title editable after.
202: 
203: ## L. Non-goals / pinned decisions
204: - Markdown rendering: FUTURE (write API to be parser-friendly — parts, no
205:   prose-heavy gating). Output contract ready for it.
206: - Media generation: IMAGE + TRANSCRIPTION SHIPPED in MVP (lazy-load provider
207:   when `IMAGE_MODEL`/`TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` configured); SPEECH/VIDEO stay schemas
208:   only until models exist. Attachments always converted to LLM-readable parts.
209: - Sub-agents in parallel: FUTURE phase (see FEATURES.md); design tool outputs as
210:   containers so sub-agent results merge into `run_activities`.
211: - Creating multiple owned workspaces: FUTURE (pro tier). MVP = 1 owned
212:   Personal workspace. No joined/invited workspaces.
213: - Single-user only: no members, no thread sharing, no share preview page,
214:   no INVITES group.
215:

218:    recoverable 30 days (trash), then hard-delete incl. Storage. Never silent.
219: 2. **Smart auto-title**: thread title automatically set from the first user
220:    message (truncated); rename still available. No blank "New thread".
221: 3. **One Run mental model**: Run button AND the LLM both fire `thread/run`
222:    (same event). WorkflowApproval dialog = max 4 buttons: Approve+Run /
223:    Approve / Decline / Edit plan. No dead dropdowns.
224: 4. **Model presets**: Agent/Env tab shows a per-provider list of known model
225:    ids (searchable) + free-text override; picks write `workspace_api_keys.model_name`.
226: 5. **Share preview page**: REMOVED (single-user). Export/import is the only
227:    way to move a thread between users.
228: 6. **Export/import thread**: single JSON (plan + steps + key messages,
229:    keys stripped) for export/import — template/reuse path.
230: 7. **Re-run**: from a past Run play a rerun with the same plan, no new chat
231:    (`runs.rerun_of`, trigger=rerun).

1: # DB — Schema (Supabase + Drizzle) — SINGLE-USER
2: 
3: > **SINGLE-USER (locked).** Membership, invites, and thread sharing are
4: > REMOVED. No `workspace_members`, `invites`, `thread_shares` tables; no
5: > `role`/`thread_role`/`invite_kind`/`invite_status` enums; no `threads.share_enabled`;
6: > no `user_profiles.prefer_own_keys_in_shared`; no INVITES system group; no
7: > multi-workspace join. Each auth user is the sole owner of their own workspace,
8: > threads, keys, and files. 14 tables.
9: 
10: Design targets: thread === workflow (1:1 after bind), chat-first, ONE Personal
11: auto workspace per user, durable chat + queued messages, binding approvals,
12: plans with steps, activities/tool streaming for ThinkingSteps, per-workspace API
13: keys, mem0 thread memory, files in Supabase Storage, realtime notifications.
14: 
15: ## Conventions
16: - Every table: `id text primary key` (prefixes per table; see below),
17:   `created_at timestamptz not null default now()`, `updated_at`.
18: - All plaintext user data (API keys, secrets) NEVER stored — use Supabase Vault
19:   or encrypted column (see `workspace_api_keys`).
20: - RLS on every user table: owner-only (`user_id` = `auth.uid()` or
